lever: tty_repro: one rule appended to the Rules list of prompts/system.md. The sandbox's output goes to a pipe, not a terminal; when the issue is about printed or displayed output, the repro turns on the library's own switch for terminal output if it has one, captures the output and prints its repr, so newlines, colours and escape codes are visible.

Over the six runs 192 repros were written and none captured a terminal-forced Live. The same program on a terminal-forced captured console with repr shows the newline (measured). Both natural shape-gated fixes pass 11 of 11 in tests/test_live.py (measured).
